uuidv7.description: Opaque record identifier: a canonical lowercase UUIDv7.

issuer.description: An OpenID Connect issuer: an https URL of visible ASCII with no user information, query or fragment, compared exactly.

subject.description: A subject identifier, unique and never reassigned within its issuer: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, compared exactly.

digest.description: SHA-256 digest of a canonical action input.

actionClass.description: Dotted lowercase governed-action name, for example fs.write.

target.description: The named setting or subject of a setting- or subject-scoped action.

permission.description: Ordered from most to least restrictive.

scopeClass.description: How the action catalogue partitions an action for authority.
